name: rosetta-summarize-and-say-sequence
code:
use default

summarize(term: string) -> string is
    let counts = MAP[char, int]()

    for digit in term do
        counts[digit] =
            (if counts.contains_key(digit) then counts[digit] else 0 fi) + 1
    od

    return
        counts.keys
        |> sort((left, right) => right <> left)
        |> map(digit => "{counts[digit]}{digit}")
        |> join("")
si

sequence(seed: int) -> LIST[string] is
    let terms = LIST[string]()
    let seen = SET[string]()

    let term mut = "{seed}"

    while seen.add(term) do
        terms.add(term)
        term = summarize(term)
    od

    return terms
si

canonical(seed: int) -> string => string("{seed}" |> sort() |> collect_array())

let lengths = MAP[string, int]()

let longest mut = 0

for seed in 1..1000000 do
    let key = canonical(seed)

    if !lengths.contains_key(key) then
        lengths[key] = sequence(seed).count
    fi

    if lengths[key] > longest then
        longest = lengths[key]
    fi
od

let winners =
    (1..1000000)
    |> filter(seed => lengths[canonical(seed)] == longest)
    |> collect_list()

write_line("seed values: {winners |> join(" ")}")
write_line("")
write_line("iterations: {longest}")
write_line("")

for term in sequence(winners[0]) do
    write_line(term)
od
